capabilities.description: Path, stream, byte, new-package, exact-copy, and preservation-aware rewrite flows.
Worksheet order, names, visibility, workbook views, and date system.
Numeric, text, rich text, Boolean, error, blank, date, shared-string, and cached formula values.
BIFF12 formulas, cached values, and supported defined-name tokens.
capabilities.note: Supported scalar, shared and fixed-array formulas can be edited, with native cached-result and calculation policies. Unchanged unsupported payloads remain native; new expressions use the bounded token encoder, including other-sheet, multi-sheet, and defined-name references.

capabilities.description: Fonts, number formats, fills, borders, alignment, protection, and cell formats.
capabilities.note: A useful style subset projects and can be generated, including built-in and custom named cell styles and differential formats. Complex gradients, style extensions, and custom table styles remain guarded.

capabilities.description: Conditional formatting rules, color scales, data bars, and icon sets.
capabilities.note: Cell-value, expression, text, date, top/bottom, average, duplicate, blank and error rules, color scales, data bars and icon sets project and are written natively; edited rules are re-encoded on rewrite. Office 2010 extension rules are preserved on import and block on generation or edit.

capabilities.description: Dimensions, rows, columns, merges, panes, views, selections, and outline metadata.
Internal and relationship-backed external hyperlinks.
Worksheet AutoFilter ranges with equality-list, custom, top-10, dynamic, and icon criteria.
capabilities.note: Color criteria remain preserved on import and block on save; native generation and loaded-package criteria rewrites support the other criteria when the filter range is unchanged.

capabilities.description: Worksheet data validation rules, messages, and ranges.
capabilities.note: List, whole-number, decimal, date, time, text-length and custom rules project and are written natively; edited rules are re-encoded on rewrite. Office 2010 validations stored in extension records are preserved but not projected.

capabilities.description: Tables, their columns, totals, styles, AutoFilters, and structured references.
capabilities.note: Tables and structured references project and are written natively, and edits to existing tables are rewritten in place. Custom table styles, sort state, query tables, and adding or removing a table in a loaded XLSB block.

capabilities.description: Legacy cell comments and their VML drawing.
capabilities.note: Comments project and are written natively, and edits to existing comments are rewritten in place. Threaded comments block, as does adding comments to a sheet of a loaded XLSB that has none.

capabilities.description: Print options, margins, page setup, and text headers and footers.
Manual row and column page breaks.
Ignored error-check ranges.
Workbook and worksheet classic protection metadata.
Supported workbook defined names and self-sheet references.
Workbook calculation mode, iteration, and related supported properties.
Core, extended, and custom document properties.
Images, shapes, controls, and drawing relationships.
capabilities.note: Worksheet drawings project into the editable model, and new workbooks write their DrawingML drawing, image, and shape parts natively. A loaded XLSB keeps its drawings unchanged; adding, removing, or editing them, SmartArt, and controls still block or use the palette-quantized cell-raster fallback.

capabilities.description: Charts and chart-sheet relationships.
capabilities.note: Worksheet charts with their styles and colors project and are written natively for new workbooks; a loaded XLSB keeps them unchanged and updates their sheet references on rename. ChartEx charts, chart edits in a loaded XLSB, and generated chart sheets still block or use the cell-raster fallback; imported chart sheets are preserved.

capabilities.description: Pivot tables, caches, slicers, timelines, and connections.
capabilities.note: Existing package parts are preservation-owned. Unsupported cross-format output either blocks or uses the omission-gated worksheet cell-raster fallback.

capabilities.description: VBA project and related macro carrier parts.
capabilities.note: Exact package copy and preservation-aware rewrites retain the carrier; conversion never treats unprojected BIFF12 records as editable parity.

capabilities.description: OLE packages, ActiveX controls, and relationship-backed embedded content.
capabilities.note: Exact package copy and preservation-aware rewrites retain the carrier; conversion never treats unprojected BIFF12 records as editable parity.

capabilities.description: Open Packaging Conventions digital signatures.
capabilities.note: Exact package copy and preservation-aware rewrites retain the carrier; conversion never treats unprojected BIFF12 records as editable parity.

capabilities.description: Unknown BIFF12 records and package parts.
capabilities.note: Exact package copy and preservation-aware rewrites retain the carrier; conversion never treats unprojected BIFF12 records as editable parity.

capabilities.description: Hash-verified original source retained beside an editable projection or visual compatibility fallback.
capabilities.note: Embedding is explicit because original bytes may contain macros, hidden sheets, or embedded payloads. PreservationOnly enables it automatically; callers can recover the verified payload through TryGetCompatibilitySourcePayload.
